description: Your own Besidka usage for the last 7 or 30 days or all time: the favorite model by replies, tokens by kind, the estimated cost on your keys, chats, messages, active days, the most active day and the current and longest streak in UTC days. Counts chat replies only; copies a branch made are counted once. Counts of projects, artifacts, skills and connectors need the projects:read, artifacts:read, skills:read and connectors:read scopes. Returns the structured data and one plain-text report to show, refreshed at most every 15 minutes (an hour for all time). Requires signing in (chats:read).
name: get_usage_stats
title: Get usage stats
